blocks.tamil_translation: a sufficient amount, and who passes his life patiently upon that. Then Rasulullah ﷺ snapped his fingers with his hand (as one snaps them to have something done quickly). Then, “His death comes quickly, the women who weep for him are very few, and the inheritance he leaves behind is very little; such a person is the one among my friends whom I envy the most,” Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ سَلْمَانَ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِ لنَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ: لَمَّا فَتَحْنَا خَيْبَرَ أَخْرَجُوا غَنَائِمَهُمْ مِنَ الْمَتَاعِ وَالسَّبْيِ فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَبْتَاعُونَ غَنَائِمَهُمْ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! لَقَدْ رَبِحْتُ رِبْحاً مَارَبِحَ الْيَوْمَ مِثْلَهُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ هذَا الْوَادِي قَالَ: وَيْحَكَ وَمَا رَبِحْتَ؟ قَالَ: مَازِلْتُ أَبِيعُ وَأَبْتَاعُ حَتَّي رَبِحْتُ ثَلَاثَمِائَةِ أُوقِيَّةٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَنَا أُنَبِّئُكَ بِخَيْرِ رَجُلٍ رَبِحَ، قَالَ: مَا هُوَ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في التجارة في الغزو، رقم:٢٦٦٧. مختصر سنن ابي داود للمنذري.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Salman (RH) narrated that one of the Sahabah said to me, “At the time we were victorious in the battle of Khaybar, the people brought out their respective items of ghanimah (spoils of war); among them were captives and goods, and they began buying and selling with one another. (Each one bought what he needed and sold what he did not need.) Meanwhile a Sahabi came to Rasulullah ﷺ and said, “Ya Rasulallah! Today in the trading I did, I gained a profit such as no one else gained.” Rasulullah ﷺ asked in surprise, “How much profit did you gain?' “From buying and
